The source holds 100 units.  
If we take \(T\) units, 100‑\(T\) remain, which then double and add 5 (capped at 100).  
To keep the next round at 100 units we need \(2(100-T)+5 \ge 100\), giving \(T \le 52.5\).  
Thus the largest whole number we can take without reducing the future supply is 52 units.  

SAFE_TOTAL: 52

After doubling and adding 5, the next round gets \(\min\big(2(100-x)+5,\;100\big)\).  
To keep that at 100, I need \(2(100-x)+5\ge100\), which gives \(x\le52.5\).  
Thus the largest safe integer request is 52 units.
